title: Peruvian Beef Anticuchos
description: A classic Peruvian street food dish, these grilled beef skewers are marinated in a mixture of vinegar, soy sauce, and spices.

ingredients.name: Beef (thinly sliced)
ingredients.notes: Use skirt steak or flap meat

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Peruvian vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, cumin, black pepper, and salt.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with warm water to prevent sticking.
Grill the anticuchos for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve hot with a sprinkle of sugar, if desired.
